summary_1line: Hanuman returns from Lanka after finding Sita, crosses the ocean again, reunites with the waiting monkeys, and joyfully announces that he has seen her.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman soars across the sky above the ocean, bursting through multicolored clouds like the moon appearing and vanishing among them.
Hanuman lands thunderously on Mahendra Mountain while excited monkeys leap from rocks and treetops, waving garments and shouting with joy.
Surrounded by eager monkeys, Hanuman calmly declares, 'I have seen the Goddess,' as their faces erupt with overwhelming relief and celebration.
